verses.text: By David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away. I’ll bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be on my lips.
With my whole soul I’ll boast in the LORD. Let the humble hear it and be glad.
Praise the greatness of the LORD with me. Let’s lift up his name together.
I sought the LORD, and he answered me. He rescued me from all my fears.
Those who look to him shine with joy. Shame will never cover their faces.
I was poor and cried out, and the LORD heard me. He saved me from all my troubles.
The angel of the LORD camps around those who fear him and rescues them.
Taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed are those who take refuge in him.
Fear the LORD, you who belong to him. Those who fear him have all they need.
Even young lions go hungry, but those who seek the LORD won’t lack any good thing.
Come, children, listen to me. I’ll teach you what it means to fear the LORD.
Who wants to live a long life and enjoy good days?
Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from lies.
Turn away from evil and do good. Seek peace and go after it.
The LORD watches over those who do right and listens when they cry out.
The LORD sets his face against those who do evil, to wipe the memory of them from the earth.
The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears them. He rescues them from all their troubles.
The LORD stays close to the brokenhearted and saves those whose spirits are crushed.
The righteous face many troubles, but the LORD rescues them from every one.
He guards all their bones. Every one stays whole.
Evil will kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous will be condemned.
The LORD redeems the lives of his servants. Everyone who takes refuge in him will escape condemnation.
